pull_request.description: ## Summary This adds phone number sign-in over SMS — the "Mobile OTP Authentication Options" item at the top of the roadmap's Planned column (30 votes) — built the way we agreed in the Discord thread with @Fermionic and Tony (Aug 12): it reuses the email OTP machinery from #1798 keyed on phone numbers, puts SMS delivery behind a provider interface with Twilio as the first implementation, and adds a Custom SMS panel next to Custom SMTP. Closes the roadmap item; the messaging docs' own "SMS — coming soon, Twilio on the back" card is what this delivers. The diff is 52 files, +4,064/−46, no new dependencies. ## Demo [ https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a99062db-993b-405c-96b9-9dd7f8ed039

InsForge: the backend where AI agents LIVE

Badge says 2xhackathon, focused mode
vraj00222 dropped a PR on main
Roadmap said 30 votes, top of the lane
Phone OTP? Discord agreed August twelve

feat/phone-otp-sms-twilio!

feat/phone-otp-sms-twilio!

[verse]
Fifty-eight files changed, four thousand seven sixty-six lines

migration 065 just dropped the NOT NULL on email — YIKES
emailCooldowns renamed identifierCooldowns, clean rebrand
destroyIdentifierCooldownInterval — catchy, demand!
Twilio hits the TWILIO_API_BASE, ten-second timeout grace
ConsoleProvider logs your OTP in dev — don't ship to prod space

coderabbitai dropped TWELVE actionable comments, bro
cubic-dev-ai scored it two out of five — little low

createEmailOTP commits the code then 429 comes
concurrent requests both pass assertCanSend — race day!
Database failure returns null: "SMS not configured" — okay!
Twilio error text leaks straight to the unauthenticated caller

[chorus]
